response.rationale: R1 (heterotopic pregnancy) is directly contradicted by ultrasound confirming a live intrauterine pregnancy and lacks any ectopic focus. R5 (hyperthyroidism) is supported by undetectable TSH and methimazole use, with no direct contradiction, though it incompletely explains the abdominal mass and high hCG. R5 is the only candidate without a fatal contradiction.

rejected.why: Directly contradicted by ultrasound showing live intrauterine pregnancy; no ectopic pregnancy evidence.
